changeSet.author: rspace
changeSet.comment: Native sequences for Communication and CommunicationTarget IDs. Each value is the top of a block of 50 IDs, so each sequence starts one block above the highest existing ID and the old hibernate_sequences counter. Inserting a full row sets a sequence's state, which START WITH cannot do from a query. A sequence left by an interrupted run is raised if too low and kept if higher. The old hibernate_sequences rows are kept for a manual rollback.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE SEQUENCE IF NOT EXISTS communication_seq INCREMENT BY 50 NOCACHE; INSERT INTO communication_seq (next_not_cached_value, minimum_value, maximum_value, start_value, increment, cache_size, cycle_option, cycle_count) SELECT v, 1, 9223372036854775806, v, 50, 0, 0, 0 FROM (SELECT GREATEST( (SELECT next_not_cached_value FROM communication_seq), (GREATEST( (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) FROM Notification), (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) FROM MessageOrRequest), (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) FROM GroupMessageOrRequest), (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) FROM CreateGroupMessageOrRequest), (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) FROM ShareRecordMessageOrRequest), (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(next_val), 0) FROM hibernate_sequences WHERE sequence_name = 'Communication') ) DIV 50 + 2) * 50) AS v) AS start_value;
CREATE SEQUENCE IF NOT EXISTS communication_target_seq INCREMENT BY 50 NOCACHE; INSERT INTO communication_target_seq (next_not_cached_value, minimum_value, maximum_value, start_value, increment, cache_size, cycle_option, cycle_count) SELECT v, 1, 9223372036854775806, v, 50, 0, 0, 0 FROM (SELECT GREATEST( (SELECT next_not_cached_value FROM communication_target_seq), (GREATEST( (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) FROM CommunicationTarget), (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(next_val), 0) FROM hibernate_sequences WHERE sequence_name = 'CommunicationTarget') ) DIV 50 + 2) * 50) AS v) AS start_value;
